nodes.title: How to use this workflow
widgets_values:
## Source video + audio inpaint experiment

1. Upload a 24 fps source video with an audio track in **Load Video**. The source is trimmed to H3-compatible length, then its frames and audio are encoded as the latent to edit.
2. Set independent video and audio start/end seconds in **INPAINT SOURCE VIDEO + AUDIO**. Defaults are 1–3 seconds because the included sample video is short. For a longer source, try 4–8 seconds.
3. Start with audio strength 1.0 and video strength 0.25. Edit the prompt to request the desired speech/visual change.
4. The final Save Video and separate MP3 both use the edited source audio. Outside the selected latent ranges, the source latent is restored exactly.
